target.title: fix(qa-channel): add timeout to qa-bus state guarded fetch
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `getQaBusState` called `fetchWithSsrFGuard` with no `timeoutMs` and no `AbortSignal`, so a loopback qa-bus peer that accepted TCP but never returned headers could hang Gateway/QA tooling forever (body idle caps never start).

## Why This Change Was Made

- Pass `timeoutMs: QA_BUS_STATE_TIMEOUT_MS` (10s) through the existing guarded fetch, matching Feishu registration / similar Type C hang floors.
- Optional `options.timeoutMs` overrides for hermetic hang regressions only; production callers omit it.
- No new config/env surface.

## User Impact

**Before:** A hung qa-bus `/v1/state` peer could pin state inspection indefinitely.

**After:** State fetches fail closed after 10s with `TimeoutError` so QA/monitor loops can continue.

## Evidence

Head: `cadb067c5abd997f396198b41094afd7e150eff2`

Executable negative control + fix proof:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-channel/src/bus-client.test.ts -- --run -t "negative control|never returns headers" --reporter=verbose
```

```text
stdout | extensions/qa-channel/src/bus-client.test.ts > qa-bus client > negative control: never-headers peer stays pending without timeoutMs
[qa-channel bus-state negative control] outcome=still-pending wait_ms=200 without_timeoutMs=true
[qa-channel bus-state hang proof] timed_out=true name=TimeoutError elapsed_ms=86 production_timeout_ms=10000
 ✓ |extension-qa| extensions/qa-channel/src/bus-client.test.ts > qa-bus client > negative control: never-headers peer stays pending without timeoutMs 253ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  2 passed | 6 skipped (8)
```

- **Negative control (executable):** pre-fix call shape — `fetchWithSsrFGuard` with **no** `timeoutMs` against the same never-headers peer stays `still-pending` after 200ms.
- **After fix:** `getQaBusState(..., { timeoutMs: 80 })` rejects with `TimeoutError` in ~80ms; production default `QA_BUS_STATE_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000`.
- Touched: `extensions/qa-channel/src/bus-client.ts` (+ colocated test). Sibling Feishu registration / other Type C floors unchanged.

AI-assisted.
